result.summary: Found 1 major issue: low-contrast text in the promo banner. The rest of the page appears visually consistent and functional.

issues.description: The promo banner heading '3 free deliveries for you' and its subtitle are rendered in white/near-white text on a very light mint-green background, making them nearly unreadable and failing WCAG contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark color (e.g., dark green or near-black) or darken the banner background to ensure sufficient contrast, also improving accessibility for low-vision users.
